notes.subject: אפדנו
notes.rationale: אַפַּדֶן (palace-tent) appears only here in the Tanakh; rendered as the compound faamaso-sogo.

notes.subject: בין ימים
notes.rationale: Dual/plural 'between the seas' (JPS, KJV) vs singular 'between the sea' (ASV, BSB); the dual kept as kɔgɔjiw.

notes.subject: צבי קדש
notes.rationale: Construct 'splendor of holiness' — do the tents sit between seas AND the holy mountain, or is the mountain itself the beautiful-holy one; rendered attributively.

notes.subject: nka
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no adversative here; 'yet/but' supplied for the contrast between pitching and coming to his end.

translation: A bɛna a ka faamaso-sogow sinsin kɔgɔjiw cɛ, sanuma-senuma kulu kan, nka a bɛna na se a ka laban ma, dɛmɛbaga si tɛ a ye.
